Suspect Sought for Arson and Shooting at Vaughan Business

Police are seeking a suspect in connection with an arson and shooting incident at a business in Vaughan. Video footage shows the suspect, who reportedly hurled rocks and doused a porch with fuel before the incident. The exact nature of the business and the extent of the damage were not specified in the coverage.
